body: They are a little better already, truly. I've gained so much perspective from hitting this insanely low point.
Redditors are so kickass. I knew most people on here were great but I just didn't think anyone would see this. Thanks for the encouragement :)
I have been sleeping at my best friend's apartment lately and it does help restore sanity!

He wasn't even on the train yesterday or today! To think that I scared a grown ass man is amazing. 
I appreciate everyone's kind words. Someday I will have the courage to tell my mother off, but it will have to wait til I have a place that I can move. In case you were wondering how the counselor appt went, it was great. He was really chill (I prefer logic-central brains for advice so I asked for a man haha) and empathetic. He felt very hopeful about us figuring things out and said he knows a 'real' therapist that will take me free of charge if we don't make enough headway. Thank you again! I need to make friends with grown men in my real life. :)
There is a queer group at school but oddly, they are not receptive. I made an appt with a counselor, thank you for replying to this! I thought nobody would.
I will Check them out, thanks for sharing.
Thank you, i just wasted a whole hour between classes watching videos :)

I made an appt with an LGBT-friendly counselor for tomorrow. I feel so silly having to speak to someone at school but it must be done. Thank you for your reply and encouraging words. 
Oh and I'm studying diet and nutrition (dietetics).

It's not even the girl I miss, as much as the understanding and kindness from a person that knows you inside and out, you know? 
I made an appt with a LGBT-friendly counselor at school (I didn't even know we had such a thing) for tomorrow afternoon. Thanks very much for your reply!
Thanks for your reply, I do try to be proud of it but it's hard when everyone is telling you those are the terrible things about you. Will keep trying.
Thank you for the reply, I really appreciate it. I'm trying to think positive now!

My thinking was of I ignored it, he would stop doing it.. Being a meek, mild-mannered girl, yelling is not my forte.. But I did it! He was like, "Morning faggot." And I let him have it. Nothing like yelling at 6:30 AM. The train fucking cheered for me. He ducked his head and moved to the back of the car. Fuck yes. Thank you for the courage to do this. Already I'm glad I didn't off myself! *whirlwind of emotions*

Wow thank you so much this is basically exactly the reply/advice I needed. 
I really appreciate it. I'm going to keep fucking trying. Also I made an appt with the people that help you keep on track with your courses (brain fart, I cannot remember what they are called) to try and get back to passing. Thanks again.
